title: Mum asks: made up
hook: Mum asked: why does AI make things up?

beats.say: Mum asks why her AI gave her a fake recipe, so confidently.

screen.title: Mum
screen.body: Why did the AI give me a FAKE recipe?? Rajma with chocolate??

beats.say: It's like the uncle at every wedding. He doesn't know, but he never says so.
He guesses what sounds right. The AI does the same. So always double check.

screen.title: Mum
screen.body:
Why did the AI give me a FAKE recipe?? Rajma with chocolate??

Ok. So the AI is your Ramesh uncle.

beats.say: She says it's basically Ramesh uncle.

caption:
mum asked why AI makes things up. claude explained it with the wedding uncle. ramesh uncle is typing.

which AI word should mum ask about next?
